name: Stillborn Babies
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the sovereign Creator who carefully forms each life in the womb, as seen in Psalms 139:13 and Job 10:8, yet He also holds authority over life and death, including untimely loss. The soul and breath of every living being are in His hand (Job 12:10), affirming His control even over stillborn babies. Ecclesiastes 3:1 reminds us that there is a divinely appointed season for every purpose, while Ecclesiastes 6:3 suggests that an untimely birth may be preferable to a life lacking fulfillment. Ultimately, believers can find hope in the living Redeemer who stands at the latter day (Job 19:25), assuring that God's purposes extend beyond earthly life.
